soc.knockout_cagey_factor.rationale: Cup knockouts reduce goals and favourite win rates, and the effect varies by round, tie format and leg; a league-fitted goal and draw rate misprices both the goalless leg and the race window in cup ties, and the extra-time and shootout mass of knockout-tie contracts.
